Name: George Stanislaus
Description: An industrialist, also the 7th richest man in America, Stanislaus sought out another dimension to plunder its resources. He hired Skull the Slayer and Lee Forrester to accompany him. He ended up allying with an alien race of invaders, the Scorpius, who were defeated. His current status is unknown.
